 Al Qadsiah Al Riyadh vs Al Qadsiah Al Riyadh Saudi Pro League Trezeguet Saudi Arabia Egypt Clash of power and ambition
 Al-Qadsiah host Al-Riyadh tonight in one of the twelfth round's most eagerly awaited fixtures in the Saudi Roshn Pro League.
 Armed with a squad packed with international and local stars, Al-Qadsiah want three points to cement their place in the race at the top. Al-Riyadh, meanwhile, are banking on their defensive organisation and the quality of their professionals to snatch a surprise in enemy territory.
